description: Explore: narrow only the middle block. Starting from E004, change the widths from 128/384/576 to 128/256/576, keeping 3 convs per block, and set epochs to 11 with the schedule rescaled. Block 2 at 16x16 is the largest FLOP share (about 0.79 of 1.6 GMACs). Block 3's width is the likeliest source of the capacity the 100-class head needs, and E007/E009 cut both blocks. Estimated conv FLOPs per epoch are about 0.72x those of the wide net.
